title: Wetland inventory, hydric soil and Corps determination checks near Stayton, Oregon
analysis_boundary: Current Marion County tax lot 091W04B001000, shown as 091W04B01000 on the Corps map, rather than the 60.9-acre Corps review area
spatial_reference: Coordinates are WGS84 longitude and latitude. Area calculations use NAD83 / Conus Albers (EPSG:5070).

wetlands.location_reported: Eastern portion of tax lot 1000. The memo says the feature extends east outside the Corps review area.

ditch_1.treatment: Keep both reported linear lengths as separate source values. Obtain the governing geometry or authorized correction before calculating impacts.

corps_determination.treatment: Agency acreage belongs to the described wetland feature. No part of the AJD was digitized or intersected with the current lot. No state authorization or developable acreage is inferred.

methods: Select one Marion County tax lot by the normalized assessor ID and preserve the returned native fields and geometry.
Retrieve National Wetlands Inventory polygons for the recorded bounding box. Convert the geometries and county parcel to EPSG:5070, union the wetlands and clip the union against the parcel.

Use Soil Data Access to retrieve SSURGO polygons intersecting the lot and the map unit component hydric ratings. Clip soils to the parcel. A component percentage is a representative percentage within the soil map unit. Its location within the unit is unknown.
Compare the published Corps feature findings from the dated memo and attached map. Keep the agency review area separate from the parcel used for the GIS overlay.
